facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 26 February 2006 a near hit was recorded on TK-4210 and PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
